title: Payment API latency spike
symptoms: Checkout requests are timing out and error rate rose above baseline after the 2:15 deployment.
error_logs: HTTP 503 responses increased sharply in production. p95 latency increased from 320ms to 5.8s.
investigation_steps: Review deployment diff; inspect DB replica saturation; verify autoscaling events.
actions_taken: Alerted on-call; reduced traffic to replica; started rollback plan.

title: Auth token refresh failures
symptoms: Users intermittently lose session after token refresh and are redirected to sign in.
error_logs: JWT validation failed for refresh requests, 429 rate-limit errors seen on token-issuer endpoint.
root_cause: Redis eviction policy caused stale refresh-token cache misses during peak traffic.
investigation_steps: Review auth logs; compare redis hit rates; isolate refresh failures to cache misses.
actions_taken: Increased cache TTL; disabled hot key eviction; added user-facing warning banner.
resolution: Cache issue stabilized after TTL adjustment and rollout to all auth pods.
postmortem: Redis memory limits were exceeded during a burst of token renewals.
lessons_learned: Pre-scale cache resources and add alerts when stale refresh token churn exceeds a threshold.

title: Search indexing lag in retailer portal
symptoms: New inventory updates are not appearing in search results for up to 15 minutes.
error_logs: Search queue depth increased 5x; consumer workers stalled after last indexer restart.
root_cause: Index worker consumers were restarted without resuming queue offsets, leading to backlog buildup.
investigation_steps: Inspect queue lag; validate consumer health; compare worker restarts with backlog spikes.
actions_taken: Rebalanced workers; manually replayed stale queue items; added restart note to runbook.
resolution: Queue backlog drained and search freshness returned to normal within 12 minutes.
postmortem: The process lacked a checkpoint during worker restarts.
lessons_learned: Add queue offset validation before worker restarts and alert on index backlog thresholds.
